posts.text: image 736×606 112 KB The claim traces to a Goldman Sachs Global Research note (cited in social posts ~Mar 2026) saying datacenters hit 7% of U.S. electricity demand now, up 1 pt in the prior year. Primary data: Lawrence Berkeley National Lab (2024 report) has 4.4% for 2023 (176 TWh). Their projection: 6.7-12% by 2028. EIA (Jan 2026) confirms data centers are the main driver of 1-3% annual U.S. demand growth through 2027, but gives no exact current %. AI-driven surge makes rapid rise plausible; official figures lag the fastest estimates.
